title: Aptoide becomes the first rival app store to return to Google Play in the US
excerpt: Aptoide has brought its games store back to Google Play after more than a decade, as court-ordered changes open Android to competing app stores.

title: Social media platforms still facing thousands of user addiction lawsuits after failed appeals
excerpt: Platforms like Meta, TikTok, Snapchat, and Google are facing a long road of litigation.

title: YouTube now requires creators to have twice as many watch hours to start earning money
excerpt: Creators who want to start earning on the platform will need at least 8,000 qualified watch hours over the past year or 20 million qualified Shorts views in the last 90 days.

title: Clicks’ Power Keyboard brings BlackBerry-style typing to any phone — with some compromises
excerpt: Clicks’ $99 Power Keyboard brings a customizable, slide-out physical keyboard to MagSafe and Qi2 smartphones, but its added heft can make larger phones awkward to use.

title: Deadly Earthquake Hits Colombia
excerpt:
A deadly earthquake hit Colombia on Monday morning, toppling buildings, burying people under rubble and causing dozens of deaths in the Pacific region and the central Andes.

 (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Avantis ETF Cracks Small-Cap Code
excerpt: Eduardo Repetto, CIO of Avantis Investors, joins Isabelle Lee and Eric Balchunas on "Bloomberg ETF IQ." They discus the Avantis U.S. Small Cap Value (ticker: AVUV). (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Chile Gives Struggling Copper Giant Codelco a $2.4 Billion Boost
excerpt: Chile’s government will allow state-owned Codelco to retain all of its 2025 profit, leaving about $2.42 billion in the copper giant as it looks to revive production and ease a record debt burden.

title: ETFs Are 'Absolutely' Mainstream: Maier
